name: Ano Hi Mita Hana no Namae wo Bokutachi wa Mada Shiranai. Movie
name_english: anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day - The Movie
name_romanji: anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day - The Movie
original_title: 劇場版 あの日見た花の名前を僕達はまだ知らない。
description: A year has passed since Menma's ghostly return to the Super Peace Busters. Although the time they spent together during that summer was short, the five members reminisce about what happened as they each write a letter to their lost friend.
